ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Web Access Installation - PsScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the installation and configuration of PowerShell Web Access, which could be used for remote access and potential abuse Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Install\\-WindowsFeature\\ WindowsPowerShellWebAccess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Install\\-PswaWebApplication.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-PswaAuthorizationRule.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-UserName\\ *.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ComputerName\\ *.*")))
